India's Summer Hill Stations to Visit with Family

The Indian government has announced plans to develop five hill stations in Himachal Pradesh, aiming to boost tourism and create jobs. The development project is expected to be completed by 2025. The government has also proposed measures to improve infrastructure and provide better amenities for tourists. The move is seen as an effort to promote family-friendly vacations and support local economies.
